incident-bot: PAGER ALERT — KV cache pressure + continuous-batching perf cliff in region us-west-2. Notifying oncall groups @oncall-anna @sre-mike @eng-runtime-raj @eng-ml-lee @support-jess. Key signals: kv_cache_size rising rapidly, eviction rate spike, p95 tailjump. Dash: https://internal.metrics/redwood/kvcache

oncall-anna: I'm on it. Gathering scope and triage now. What's customer impact?

support-jess: We have two customer support tickets reporting 5-12s tail latencies and a single timeout from enterprise-gamma. A hosted tenant also saw 503 spikes. Tickets RD-13001, RD-13002.

sre-mike: Observed: kv_cache_size jumped ~10x in 18m, paging thrash, and continuous-batching is aggregating long-running model calls with short ones — pack fairness gone. Current quick metrics:
```
kv_cache_size_gb: 102.7
eviction_rate_s: 5.1
batch_inflight_long_pct: 62
batch_queue_depth: 94
p95_latency_ms: 3140
```

eng-runtime-raj: I deployed a packing density tweak earlier (yesterday) that tightened coalescing thresholds. Reproducer with mixed short/long synthetic workload shows identical behavior. Suspect packing heuristic + prefetch caused cache blowout. Starting a canary rollback of the heuristic to 5% of the pool.

oncall-anna: Initial mitigation plan:
1) rollback packing heuristic to previous stable on a canary subset.
2) reduce MAX_BATCH_SIZE to temporarily cap batch growth.
3) enable explicit long-request lane to isolate slow requests.
4) run staggered KV eviction to bring memory down without a cold-start avalanche.
I'll coordinate steps and post commands.

eng-ml-lee: For hotfix, can we limit per-worker long_request_slots to 2 and deprioritize prefetch for mixed workloads? That should reestablish fairness quickly.

sre-mike: Applying mitigations now. Commands being executed: 
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/batch-scheduler MAX_BATCH_SIZE=48 --record
curl -X POST 'https://admin.internal/api/cache/evict' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"zone":"us-west-2","pct":35}'
```
Applying to canary subset first.

incident-bot: Impact estimate: hosted latency increase ~2-4% globally, affected tenants ~1-3% higher error surface. Severity P2.

eng-runtime-raj: Canary rollback in place on 5% of nodes; initial telemetry shows cache pressure easing on those nodes. Promoting rollback to 30% with MAX_BATCH_SIZE enforcement.

support-jess: Sending interim notices to impacted customers: "We're investigating elevated tail latencies; mitigation underway; ETA 45 minutes for stabilization."

oncall-anna: Kicking off staggered eviction: evict 10% node groups every 2 minutes to avoid a fill wave. Monitoring p50/p95/error-rate.

sre-mike: After first two eviction waves and canary promotions, metrics evolving:
```
[11:02] evict: removed ~1.5GB per node group
[11:05] kv_cache_size_gb: 102.7 -> 41.3
[11:07] p95_latency_ms: 3140 -> 720
```

eng-runtime-raj: Pushing hotfix to scheduler: set long_request_slots=2 and enable short-request prioritization. Rolling in 10% increments.

incident-bot: suppressing repeat alerts for same signals for 20m window.
